scenario_contracts: Every frozen body independently uses strict runtime compilation and serialized artifact materialization; no same-result route aliases.
Native legal casts pay combined printed and mandatory additional costs; zero X remains an accepted obligation.
Mana plus controlled untapped artifact/creature taps, including newly cast creatures; tapped, opposing, phased and noneligible permanents rejected.
Multiple obligations remain distinct; ordinary printed or added generic mana and colored pips cannot be replaced by waterbend taps.
Water Whip zero, one and two targets; complete bounce and draw tail; Spirit flying, ward and actual enters scry.
Crashing Wave zero and nonzero X; distribution recomputes current tapped opponents after its tap instruction.
Foggy Swamp Visions actual graveyard producers, partial invalidity, exact copy counts and own-next-end-step sacrifice.
Restoration exact exiled references, opponent next end step, moved-away cards and owner control on return.
Lesson draws before pay-or-discard, paid, declined and insufficient payment branches.
Native payment pending, cancellation after a manual mana activation, rejected response and stale-plan rollback.
Katara migration only: nonzero X, own turn, all current creatures and cleanup of base power/toughness.
